about: a mutable default argument shared between calls
diff: # Tag helpers used by the importer.

answer.title: Default tag list is shared between calls
answer.description: The default [] is created once, when the function is defined. add_tag("a") then add_tag("b") returns ["a", "b"] on the second call, so tags leak from one import into the next.
answer.evidence: def add_tag(tag: str, tags: list[str] = []) -> list[str]:
answer.suggestion: Default to None and create the list inside: def add_tag(tag, tags=None): tags = [] if tags is None else tags.

about: a generator read twice, so the second pass is empty
diff: +    paid = (invoice.amount for invoice in fetch_invoices(customer_id) if invoice.paid)
+    return total / count if count else 0.0

answer.title: Paid amounts are counted after the generator is used up
answer.description: paid is a generator, and sum(paid) on line 5 reads it to the end. The second pass on line 6 sees nothing, so count is always 0 and average_paid returns 0.0 for every customer, even one with paid invoices of 10 and 30 (expected 20.0).
answer.suggestion: Build a list once and use it twice: paid = [invoice.amount for invoice in fetch_invoices(customer_id) if invoice.paid]; return sum(paid) / len(paid) if paid else 0.0.
